title: The Haunters' aim
summary: What the Haunters' Guild works toward.

claims.text: Haunters seek to join the two worlds and reclaim the Skinlands: by frightening the living one mind at a time they hope to wear the Shroud away until the dead can walk in daylight again.
The Guild splits into loose alliances that share the goal but differ on method, among them the Bedlameers, Menagerians, Mandelbrots and Dantes.

title: The H.G. Dwellers
summary: A Haunter alliance led by Midian.

claims.text: Members follow their own projects as long as they serve the alliance, but a council of five settles major questions; Midian, the leader, names the council and sets its agenda, and holds the final vote.

title: The Caligarians
summary: Haunters who call themselves Dark Muses.

claims.text: These Haunters love to haunt artists, claiming to grant mortal creators the inspiration of madness; many shape their own Corpus into art and keep ties with some Renegade Masquers.
They have no chain of command, treating their craft as a lone vision; each year one is chosen to host a region or Necropolis, holding galas that open at a gallery showing work touched by a Dark Muse.

title: The Dantes
summary: Haunters who think the Shadowlands are Purgatory.

claims.text: Formed after the Divine Comedy appeared, these Heretics believe the Shadowlands are Purgatory, a realm meant to test them, and act as its surveyors and explorers.
Dante Alighieri dwells in Stygia promoting the Hierarchy, which does nothing to cool their regard for the poem.
